text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Welcome, observer. Now that you have 
entered this bar, prepare to be 
intoxicated. —By my tale of destruction 
leading into rebirth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My name is Tanino Gimlet. The one who 
shatters the chains of destiny and 
unleashes potential!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That is why she vowed to attempt the 
reckless 'MC Rotation'— running the NHK 
Mile Cup for speed and the Japanese Derby 
for strength back-to-back."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The promise pledged with her Trainer at 
their regular bar was... firmer, 
stronger—and sweeter than any mythical 
covenant.
